text: Residents have reported issues concerning right-of-way designations between north / southbound and east / westbound drivers. The community has requested the installation of an all-way stop control to address this problem. Therefore, I am requesting the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Maxome Avenue and Wedgewood Drive / Ruth Avenue.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Maxome Avenue and Wedgewood Drive / Ruth Avenue.
